reviews.x: The 10x magnification side looks like a fun house mirror.  Horrible.  I can’t see a thing.  I will be returning this item.
This mirror has a very nice magnification (10x) with a very good optical quality. The light is bright and you can dim it, if necessary. Very nice manufacture. Definitely would recommend that product.

Very Clear bright mirror. Almost distortionless, even though magnifying. This lighted mirror holds its charge well. The bright LED light allows you to see things that you could not before- more like outside in the sunlight ( OMG !  Thank God I could get rid of those things I did not see before!!!!)It can be kept plugged in if you prefer. The light is on a dimmer- just play with the on/off button and you will be pleasantly surprised. Too large to travel with, but really great for home use. The sw

I purchased this mirror based on the great reviews I read, and they were spot on! It’s the perfect size, the light dims to what you need and it’s double sided so I can see what I need to. I already love it and I’ve only had it a few days.

reviews.t: Highly recommend this if your a plucker
reviews.x: I got yhos for my daughter and she loved it ! I was bummed i didnt order me one. The magnification  is awesome and light is so bright ! Her and I had a an eyebrow plucking party lol

I'm nearsighted so I have to lean over and get real close to the bathroom mirror to apply my makeup. Now I could just sit comfortably in a chair and bring the mirror up close to me. The LED light is a great feature and I love that I don't have to sit near a wall plug to use this mirror because once it is charged up, I can use it anywhere.

reviews.t: LED light does not stay on
reviews.x: The LED light that surrounds the mirror does not stay on.  It continuously flickers, especially if the mirror is swiveled, sometimes going out completely.  It's unfortunate the lamp has this issue because the overall design and look of the product is great.  Missed return window, so now my girlfriend is stuck with it.

This is a great mirror for applying make up and for seeing all of your flaws close up! I love that it is rechargeable so it can be placed anywhere and does not take up plug space. It is easy to use and looks good too. I would highly recommend it

reviews.t: Bright and rechargeable, two thumbs up!
reviews.x: This mirror is great! Got as a gift and couldn't be happier. It's rechargeable and holds a charge for a week with daily use. Highly recommend!

Bought this mirror for my girlfriend for her birthday. It was perfect.... WAS  Ordered this on the 25th of September for her birthday on the 5th of October... it is now the 17th and the light around the mirror is so dim. Yes it’s plugged in and yes the light is turned all the way up. Not worth the money. Find a better one

The absolute, only thing that could make this makeup mirror any better is if it could "extend" to be a little taller. However, I simply prop it up on something stable.  I easily packed it into my check-bag when I flew out of state.  Since I am an esthetician, I especially love the magnification side. Not only is it nice for makeup application, but it is also easier to do my own extractions!... and to verify my makeup has been thoroughly removed when cleansing. It is rechargeable, so remember the

The light on this mirror is fine however the magnification is well, NOT good at all.  I have a small hand held mirror without a light and it has much more magnification than this mirror.  I would not recommend this product especially for the amount of money I paid for this.  My friend has a magnifying mirror that she got from Costco that is way better than this one.  It's quiet unfortunate as my schedule is very busy and I don't need to waste time going to return it.

reviews.t: Light stopped working within a few uses.
reviews.x: It was glitchy when I first started using it - the light would only come on if the mirror was at certain angles and would flicker. But I figured, oh well, didn't pay that much for it. But within two months, the button to turn the light off and on has completely stopped working. The light no longer works. Doesn't matter how long I charge it for or whether or not it is plugged in. It's just a plain old mirror now.

The light doesn’t work. The wiring is probably wrong as it goes on and off by itself. Also when trying to change the intensity by pressing the light button as per the instruction, the only result is the light annoyingly flickering. It may just be a particularly bad mirror. Returning.
Thought it was ok for traveling,  however it already no n longest works Save your money

I purchased two other mirrors before finding this one, which is a keeper.  The mirror is not heavy but has a solid base so it's not going to tip over.  The height of the mirror (approx 13 inches) is perfect and allows me to use it without having to set it on something to raise it. The magnification side is great and really lets you see your face clearly, flaws and all.  There is no "trick" to getting the magnification side to work, simply move closer to the mirror until the distortion is gone an

I just bought this mirror and I LOVE it! I was worried it would be too small, but really it is a fine size. The lighting is quite adequate and the 10X mirror is perfect for plucking. I am very happy with this purchase. It is beautiful and works great! Great price, too! Many comparable ones are going for $200 so this is a steal!

I like it!  It's not tall enough to be able to have it on the counter top and me standing, so I sit and use it (I don't have a vanity, but I make it work).  If you have a vanity, this is PERFECT!  I'm not a heavy makeup user (therefore, don't use it much each day), but I've had it several weeks and have yet to recharge it.

I like the light and the fact is is chargeable, no bulbs or batteries. The magnification is good. Only negative is that the stem could be longer. If you are sitting at vanity I am sure it is good but if you don't have that option it is a little low. I use a small box to raise the height. Otherwise nice little makeup mirror

You will love the mirror but I bet everyone wishes for it to have a larger mirror area. Magnification is great and I wouldnt give the mirror away for nothing. For the price im happy that it has built in battery and microusb port for charging. Definitely recommending this nice mirror with brightness adjustment. Loving it!

reviews.t: Finally a light up mirror I don't have to plug in to use!!
reviews.x: Every light up mirror I've owned in the past I've had to plug in with the big ac adapter plug to be able to use the light feature. Ain't nobody got time for dat! Finally, a mirror I can just push a button for the light. Holds a charge great, haven't even had to charge it yet and I've had it for a couple months.

I loved the mirror when I first bought it. However, after having it for a little over a year, the USB charger no longer works for the mirror. The charger works for a small travel mirror I have so the issue is the mirror. Now the light will not come on. I loved it until I could no longer charge it.

Holds a long charge! Super bright!  My daughter has used it every night since it was delivered. I waited to review to see how well it worked and it’s pretty awesome. It’s still charged and she’s used it a lot. I haven’t heard any issues. She said she likes that it has two mirrors.

I love that the light is rechargeable.  It is lightweight for travel although a little bulky.  Maybe my old eyes just need a light similar to the interrogation lights in old movies, but even when charged, it doesn't seem as bright as my old one.

reviews.t: This is a very nice quality mirror!
reviews.x: I love this mirror! Holds a charge great, with daily use I charge it maybe once a week. Magnification side is great, I can see ALL my imperfections, lol. Feels sturdy, has a solid base and light is very bright! I am glad I bought this mirror.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the bright LED light and its dimming feature.
Several reviewers report the light failing, flickering, or going dim over time.
The rechargeable, cordless design is frequently appreciated for portability and holding a charge.
Opinions on the 10x magnification are split, with some finding it clear and others finding it distorted or weak.
Reviewers commonly describe the mirror as a good size and well made.
